name: Kinetic / death

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. One heavy blunt body-sized impact, a dense low thud with a dry gritty crunch and falling small debris. Mechanical kinetic energy ends in one hit, no repeated pulses.
